description: Infrastruktur-Monitoring für Proxmox VE Cluster/VMs/Storages, SNMP-Switches & Firewalls (IF-MIB), USV-Stützzeit/Last, Synology/QNAP-NAS, RFC-3805-Netzwerkdrucker und Syslog.

targets.expr: min(pve_up{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", id=~"cluster/.*"} or pve_cluster_quorate{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}) or vector(1)
count(pve_up{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", id=~"node/.*"} == 1) or vector(0)
count(pve_up{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"} == 1) or vector(0)

count((pve_onboot_status{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"} == 1) and on (customer, site, instance, id) (pve_up{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"} == 0)) or vector(0)
count(up{device_role=~"snmp-.*", customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} == 1) or vector(0)

count((upsOutputSource{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} == 5) or (upsBasicOutputStatus{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} == 3) or (upsBatteryStatus{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} == 3)) or vector(0)
min(upsEstimatedMinutesRemaining{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"})

count((raidStatus{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} >= 11) or (diskStatus{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} >= 4) or (qnapVolumeStatus{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", qnapVolumeStatus!="", qnapVolumeStatus!~"(?i)^(ready|ok|normal).*"} == 1) or (qnapVolumeStatus{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", qnapVolumeStatus=""} > 1) or (qnapVolumeStatus{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", qnapVolumeStatus=""} < 0)) or vector(0)
pve_cpu_usage_ratio{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", id=~"node/.*"} * 100
pve_iowait_ratio{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", id=~"node/.*"} * 100

(pve_memory_usage_bytes{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", id=~"node/.*"} / (pve_memory_size_bytes{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", id=~"node/.*"} > 0)) * 100
pve_disk_size_bytes{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", id=~"storage/.*"}
pve_disk_usage_bytes{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", id=~"storage/.*"}

(pve_disk_usage_bytes{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", id=~"storage/.*"} / (pve_disk_size_bytes{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", id=~"storage/.*"} > 0)) * 100
topk(10, pve_cpu_usage_ratio{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"} * 100)
topk(10, pve_memory_usage_bytes{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"})
pve_up{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"}
pve_cpu_usage_ratio{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"} * 100
pve_memory_usage_bytes{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"}
(rate(ifHCInOctets{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) or rate(ifInOctets{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) * 8
(rate(ifHCOutOctets{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) or rate(ifOutOctets{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) * 8

((((rate(ifHCInOctets{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) or rate(ifInOctets{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) + (rate(ifHCOutOctets{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) or rate(ifOutOctets{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))) * 8) / (((ifHighSpeed{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} * 1000000) or ifSpeed{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}) > 0)) * 100

sum by (customer, site, instance, ifName) (rate(ifInErrors{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) + rate(ifOutErrors{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))

sum by (customer, site, instance, ifName) (rate(ifInDiscards{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) + rate(ifOutDiscards{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))
upsEstimatedChargeRemaining{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} or upsAdvBatteryCapacity{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}
upsOutputPercentLoad{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} or upsAdvOutputLoad{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}
upsEstimatedMinutesRemaining{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}

diskTemperature{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} or qnapDiskTemperature{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} or systemTemperature{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}

((prtMarkerSuppliesLevel{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} >= 0) / ignoring (prtMarkerSuppliesDescription) group_left (prtMarkerSuppliesMaxCapacity{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} > 0)) * 100
{customer=~"$customer", site=~"$site", device_role=~"proxmox|snmp-.*"}
